title: fix(service-settings)!: a host that binds its own engine and states no organization source reads and writes as the organization D9 derives
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuSQfvzuV2ZjD9aZ44eAhnVq)_

Fixes #25249

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Ruling-ref: 6355249103 (letter A). Why `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: nothing is added to any accept set. `SettingsServiceOptions` and the `bindEngine` extras are unchanged. What narrows is which organization a host that binds its own engine, and states no organization source, reads and writes as.

## What changed

`SettingsService.organizationReachOf` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts`) now takes ADR-0131 D9's answer from `organizationDecision()`:

1. the stated `organization` source, when the host bound one (the plugin always does);
2. no engine at all (the in-memory store): `no-organization-object`, as before;
3. otherwise `resolveGuestOrganization(this.engine, posture)`, the same call the plugin's source makes, through the engine the service holds.

There is no second predicate, no registry-sniffing arm, and no `catch` around the probe. An engine that exposes no `registry` (the plugin's own `wrapEngineAsSettingsEngine`, any hand-written `SettingsEngine`) cannot say the organization object is absent, so D9 reads it as registered and asks `sys_organization`. A lean self-binding host declares the composition at its bind site: `bindEngine(engine, audit, { organization: async () => ({ kind: 'no-organization-object' }) })`, or hands over an engine whose `registry.getObject` answers.

The retired docblock sentence ("Unset … reads as a composition that registers no organization object") is rewritten on the source type, its field and the `bindEngine` extra. The `index.ts` host paragraph gains the declaration line and names the symptom of omitting it. No `docs/adr` edit.

Also: a changeset (`@objectstack/service-settings` patch, BREAKING, FROM/TO, the one-line fix).

## Branch

The harness assigned the branch `claude/project-thread-c4vx2u`, not the repo-convention `claude/issue-25249-…`. This note is for the Duplicate Fix Guard. The card's `Claim:` (6354964172) names this branch.

## Tests

Premises P1–P4 of the ruling were re-read on the branch before the migration: `registryHoldsObject` answers `true` with no `registry.getObject` (core `resolve-authz-context.ts:1235`); `wrapEngineAsSettingsEngine` returns `find` / `insert` / `update` only and forwards `find` verbatim; the plugin's only `bindEngine` call states a source; the plugin is the only non-test constructor in the repo. All four hold.

**Migration (45 tests in 7 files, red on the route alone).** Each suite now states its composition truthfully, through a shared testkit (`src/__tests__/settings-organization.testkit.ts`):
- a suite over a double states `LEAN_ORGANIZATION_SOURCE` at its bind: `settings-getmany`, `settings-user-rung-owner.pin`, `settings-system-context.pin` (its constructor-engine case moves to `bindEngine` with the same crypto provider and secret store);
- a suite running the real `ObjectQL` behind the production adapter forwards that engine's `registry` (`withEngineRegistry`), so D9 answers `no-organization-object` itself: `settings-secret-rotation`, `sys-secret-orphan-report`, `settings-global-rung`, `settings-user-reference.pin`.

No default in the service, no stub `getObject`, no new input. The four construction sites outside the package pass `{ env }` and no engine; they are untouched.

**Pins** (`settings-organization-reach.pin.test.ts`, new section):
- (a) a registry-less adapter over a real engine holding one `sys_organization` row, no source: the tenant and user rungs read and write as that organization, and the rows with no organization do not answer;
- (b) no organization object, no source: on the real engine, `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` naming `sys_organization` (pinned as measured; `isMissingTableError` not widened); on a double whose probe answers nothing, no tenant rung and the tenant write refused (`SETTINGS_VALIDATION`);
- (c) a stated lean source: rows with no organization read and written, unchanged;
- (d) no engine: the in-memory store unchanged;
- (e) the existing plugin pins keep their assertions.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed route): the engine branch of `organizationDecision` replaced by the old lean answer. (a) and both (b) pins went red; (c), (d) and the plugin pins (e) stayed green, the expected direction. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Runs on `e12143e6` (after merging `origin/main`):
- `vitest run` in `packages/services/service-settings`: 58 files / 987 tests passed (982 before the new pins).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings typecheck`: exit 0.
- Derived gates, the full dogfood battery (`!` title) and the contract-review-tier review: reported on the card in the os-dev-report and on this PR.

## Out of scope

Hosts outside this repo that bind `SettingsService` themselves (cloud control-plane mocks, embedded runtimes) are downstream of the published package. The changeset's FROM / TO and its one-line fix are the hand-off; no cloud card is filed from here.
